h01.photoRealism: Ash lobes, smooth white pileus, ocean and broken cloud deck read as an orbital photograph; no obvious tiled surface.
h01.cameraMatch: Oblique look-down and lower-central plume retained approximately; plume top appears somewhat higher/smaller than simulated cap. Exact camera/FOV match not proven.
h01.takenFromRealReferences: Tan cauliflower column, smooth white pileus, island slopes, cloud clearing, soft cast shadow.
h01.invented: Cloud layout, plume snapshot, island details and lighting interpreted; historical image registration and exact eruption dimensions not verified.
h01.excludedOverlays: No visible frame, controls, astronaut silhouette, globe, labels or watermark.
h01.nativeSizeCaveat: Native 3:4 checked separately; no resize to the iPad reference dimensions.

h02.photoRealism: Fine land/cloud texture, muted blue sea and broad buff ash veil; near-vent column more sculpted than real reference.
h02.cameraMatch: Wide steep obliquity retained, but source-authorized re-centering FAILED: vent remains at about x0.62,y0.70 rather than center.
h02.takenFromRealReferences: Broad diffuse tan ash plume, translucent downwind filaments and muted sea/land colors.
h02.invented: Exact ash shape/cloud positions; crater and local coastline relation not reliable. Etna appears close to Sicily's northeastern tip; location not independently verified.
h02.excludedOverlays: No visible Cupola frame, interface or text.

h03.photoRealism: Fine irregular marine clouds, turbulent ash umbrella and shadow read as a natural orbital photograph.
h03.cameraMatch: Small lower-central eruption and distant elongated island broadly follow game field of view; exact pixel/FOV match not proven.
h03.takenFromRealReferences: Rough flattened tan umbrella, dark vertical ash column, white low cloud collar and long dark shadow.
h03.invented: Exact cloud field, plume geometry, distant island surface detail and instantaneous illumination; no survey or historical-geographic validation.

h04.photoRealism: Irregular natural cloud/ash microstructure, soft sunlight and subdued ocean; no apparent plastic or repeated pattern.
h04.cameraMatch: Huge partially cropped umbrella and curved far edge at upper-third broadly follow game; lower central bulge added from real reference. Exact FOV/scale not calibrated.
h04.takenFromRealReferences: GOES turbulent overshoot dome, layered umbrella and uneven concentric rings; next-day ISS atmospheric softness.
h04.invented: Color from grayscale source interpreted; exact 15 January plume snapshot, 500 km diameter and ring altitude not validated. Next-day ISS source is not same event instant.
h04.excludedOverlays: No frame, UI, text, logos or stars.

h05.photoRealism: Dark regional night view, narrow fissure, broken glowing lava crust and orange-lit steam; white-hot fissure core somewhat intense.
h05.cameraMatch: Low-central fissure, upper city cluster and coast roughly match game; exact orbital camera/scale unverified.
h05.takenFromRealReferences: Cracked lava crust, local orange illumination of turbulent steam, darkness beyond.
h05.invented: Regional light pattern/coast geometry and eruption snapshot interpreted; close-range and other-eruption references are appearance guidance, not proof of Sundhnukur historical geography.
h05.excludedOverlays: Frame/panels/labels/astronaut removed, BUT a small pale circular spot within the main city lights may retain the game's location marker; not accepted as clean photo without recipient review.

h06.photoRealism: Cloud details persist within soft dark oval; bright surrounding day, restrained blue limb, natural orbital appearance.
h06.cameraMatch: Level broad limb and roughly upper-half black space retained; generated limb sits somewhat higher than game. Exact registration not proven.
h06.takenFromRealReferences: Broad diffuse umbra and penumbra, blue atmosphere, gradual shading over textured clouds.
h06.invented: 2026 cloud field, shadow position/diameter and land details inferred from different-eclipse 2024 photographs; not an ephemeris-validated eclipse simulation.
h06.excludedOverlays: No visible spacecraft, frame, text, point marker or stars.

h07.photoRealism: Natural cloud detail, restrained low-angle sunlight and diffuse remote dark band; no film grading or obvious repeated texture.
h07.cameraMatch: High nearly level limb and distant shadow retained broadly; generated land/coast layout differs from game and identification as Iberia is unverified. Do not use as a geographic target.
h07.takenFromRealReferences: Remote elongated soft umbra and bright foreground cloud texture, subtle blue atmosphere and pale warm far highlights.
h07.invented: Clouds, land geometry and eclipse placement; exact 2026 ephemeris and solar/observer geometry not validated.
h07.excludedOverlays: No visible map labels/point markers, ISS hardware or stars.

h08.photoRealism: Convective cloud towers, sunlit eyewall and shaded floor have convincing natural fine texture, no repeated game tiles.
h08.cameraMatch: Eye is roughly upper-middle but larger and slightly right/lower than game; generated stadium view is somewhat more oblique. Exact camera/zoom lock not achieved.
h08.takenFromRealReferences: High uneven stadium eyewall, blue-gray shaded inner wall, low cloud floor, mixed rough convection and smooth cirrus.
h08.invented: Exact storm snapshot, eyewall height, small-scale clouds and Sun/observer geometry interpreted; no calibrated hurricane geometry.
h08.excludedOverlays: No visible frame, interface, locator dot, labels, logos or ocean border.

h09.takenFromRealReferences: Continuous bright canopy, small physical eyewall, irregular spiral convection, peripheral wispy cirrus and open Atlantic.
h09.invented: Cloud layout, storm radius, eye dimensions and illumination interpreted; no historical image registration or calibrated geometry.

h10.takenFromRealReferences: Thin bright young trail, very faint aged cirrus, crossing routes and irregular spreading edges.
